mentions.title: King bearings problem
mentions.snippet: Moparts thread titled as a King bearings problem. Search results in the same set describe a buyer reporting a manufacturing flaw on a roughly $100 set and a warranty claim being declined, but that detail is not confirmed against this thread itself and should be read before any reply.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread: poster reports King 2024-production main thrust bearings are out of spec on free spread, slipping into the cap and block groove with no interference fit, and says King tech support advised returning them. Risk of spinning the thrust main is the stated concern.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully again: no King or official reply, thread still open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the poster reports NOS Clevite thrust bearings measured in spec.

mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread about King-brand rod bearings on a BMW N54; the poster reports the engine seized during installation and tells other builders to check King bearings before fitting them.
mentions.replyNote: Still returns HTTP 403 Forbidden; thread content could not be read.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: Reports King STDX thrust bearings for the BMW S85 measuring over 1mm too narrow to fit the block, with the poster saying the problem repeated across more than one block. A dimensional defect claim, not an install error.
mentions.replyNote: Still 307-redirects to the tollbit.m5board.com mirror instead of returning thread content; redirect not followed.

mentions.title: Got a set of King SI bearings with a defective bearing...awesome
mentions.snippet: Single-set quality complaint: a King SI main shell described as malformed in production, crushed and twisted so it would not fit, plus swarf and oil found in the shrink wrap of the matching rod bearings.
mentions.replyNote: Previously readable, but today it 307-redirects to the tollbit.nastyz28.com mirror instead of returning thread content; redirect not followed.

mentions.title: Just call it what it is---King Bearings are no longer an option....
mentions.snippet: Thread title writes King off for the 4G63 6-bolt community; the discussion points builders to ACL, TBS and OEM alternatives instead. Framed as availability rather than a defect, but it reads as a brand write-off to anyone scanning the forum.
